scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Promotion Of Guru-Shishya Parampara (Repertory Grant)
other_conditions: Organization must have a repertoire of adequate number and quality and have performed on an all‑India basis
Only one grant per financial year per organization
Physical verification is compulsory after every fourth year for continuation of assistance
For renewal, the organization must stage at least two productions in the financial year, one of which must be a new production
The organization must organize at least two cultural activities in schools and obtain a certificate from the school principal for renewal
Videos of productions or activities must be uploaded on YouTube and links to Ministry of Culture’s social media pages must be provided for renewal
Application must be recommended by the concerned State Government/UT Administration or recognised academies (e.g., NSD, Kalakshetra, CCRT, IGNCA, ZCCs)
All applicant organizations must register on the NGO‑PS portal (https://ngodarpan.gov.in/) to obtain a system‑generated Unique ID and must include “Art and Culture” as a key working area
Aadhaar and PAN numbers of board members/office bearers must be updated on the NGO‑PS portal
benefits_summary: Provides monthly financial assistance of ₹15,000 per Guru/Director and ₹2,000‑₹10,000 per artist depending on age category.
documents_required: Hard copy of the application form with checklist enclosures
Certificate from the principal of the school confirming two cultural activities
Proof of registration on the NGO‑PS portal (Unique ID)
Aadhaar and PAN numbers of board members/office bearers
